rule.note: Midnight at 14% alpha. Hairline on light grounds. No ramp; alpha tokens stay as written.

rule-strong.note: Midnight at 32% alpha. Head rules and field borders on light grounds.

rule-dark.note: Ivory at 18% alpha. Hairline on midnight and ink grounds.

rule-dark-strong.note: Ivory at 42% alpha. Dark ghost button border.

soft-ivory.note: Ivory at 72% alpha. Secondary text on dark grounds.

hover-tint.note: Literal value in site.css (.sum .h hover). The only hover fill in the system.

display.purpose: Hero H1 only. Two balanced lines.

headline.purpose: Section H2s, capped at 18ch. Brief page H1.

title.purpose: H3s inside panels. Row and list titles sit at 19 to 22px in the same face.

body.purpose: Paragraphs capped at 38em. Secondary descriptions step to 16, 15.5 and 15px in slate.

small.purpose: Helper text and summary cell copy.

ui.purpose: Navigation links, buttons, arrow links, details summaries.

label.purpose: Uppercase column and field heads: table headers, checklist heads, network list heads, facts, footer heads.

numeral.purpose: Tabular 01 to 06 index numbers on rows, capabilities, stages and industries.

caption.purpose: Photograph captions, hero places line, legends, legal line, hints.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only easing curve. Every transition uses it.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Button, colour and border state changes; tab crossfades (JS FADE constant).

motion.name: mid
motion.purpose: Process stage line travel; photograph fade swap.

motion.name: check-draw
motion.purpose: Quality checklist tick stroke draws in on scroll reveal.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll reveal on data-reveal elements; fires once, 5s fallback.

motion.name: route-draw
motion.purpose: Network map route line draws once when revealed.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables all of the above.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.note: max-width. Gutter 32px, section 72px, grid collapses to single column, selectable lists become horizontal tab strips.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.note: max-width. Gutter 20px, section 64px, H1 40px, H2 31px, H3 24px, body 16px, nav links behind Menu button.

photography.rule: Contained in grid columns, never full-bleed, no text over the image.

narrative.overview:
Averon Global reads like the prospectus of an international supply house, not the portfolio of a creative agency. One 12-column grid carries everything. Content is organised as numbered rows, ruled lists and tables that a procurement manager can scan several items at a time. Photographs of presses, board, finishing and inspection sit inside grid columns at fixed aspect ratios and are never allowed to bleed to the viewport edge or carry text. Type is a book serif (STIX Two Text) at restrained sizes for everything the visitor reads, with a small tracked grotesque (Archivo) for labels, numbering, navigation and buttons.

Depth is drawn, not lit. Surfaces are flat; structure comes from 1px rules at low alpha and from the alternation of three grounds (ivory, white, midnight) down the page. There are no shadows, no gradient fills, no glow, no parallax and nothing that loops. Motion exists only as a response to the visitor: a 220ms crossfade when a tab changes, a 4px arrow travel on hover, a 600ms rise on scroll reveal, a route line that draws once.

The system confirms the rejections the owner set: not a cinematic portfolio (no full-bleed hero, pinned stages or giant display type) and not a SaaS template (no rounded cards with icons, no gold, no glowing blue graphics).
keyCharacteristics: One 12-column grid, 1280px maximum, with 24px gutters and fluid 48 to 72px margins
Three grounds in rotation (ivory, white, midnight) with ink navy reserved for the footer and photograph wells
1px hairline rules carry all structure; no shadows, no gradient fills
Serif for reading, tracked sans for apparatus (labels, numerals, navigation, buttons)
Photographs contained in grid columns at 4:3, 3:2, 16:10, 3:4 or 1:1, 4px radius, no overlaid text
Rows, lists and tables over cards; only two rounded elements exist (buttons and photographs)
Motion is brief, triggered and never continuous

rules.name: The Three Grounds Rule
rules.body: Sections alternate between ivory, white and midnight; ink is reserved for the footer and photograph wells. No fourth ground, no tints, no gradient fills.

rules.name: The Alpha Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every divider is 1px and takes its colour from the ground's text colour at 14% or 32% alpha (18% or 42% on dark). Rules are never a solid grey.

rules.name: The Accent of State Rule
rules.body: Atlantic appears only as a response (ghost button hover, focus outline). It is never used as a fill, heading colour or decoration.

rules.name: The Regular Weight Rule
rules.body: No text is bold. Serif text is weight 400; Archivo apparatus is weight 500. Emphasis is carried by size, slate versus midnight, and position in the grid.

rules.name: The Apparatus Rule
rules.body: Archivo appears only at 14px and below (buttons and navigation at 13.5px, labels at 11.5px, numerals at 12px). Anything the visitor reads as a sentence is set in STIX Two Text.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Paragraphs are capped between 34em and 46em. Headlines are capped at 18ch. No line of body copy runs the full grid.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, text-shadow, drop-shadow filter or gradient fill anywhere. If an element needs separation, give it a 1px rule or move it to the next ground.

rules.name: The Drawn Depth Rule
rules.body: The only overlapping surface is the sticky navigation, which gains a 1px rule after 8px of scroll rather than a shadow.

rules.name: The Two Radii Rule
rules.body: Only buttons and photographs carry the 4px radius. Rows, lists, tables and sections stay square. Cards do not exist.

dos: Do place every element on the 12-column grid with 24px gutters inside the 1280px container, and keep section padding between 72 and 104px.
Do rotate section grounds through ivory, white and midnight, using ink only for the footer and photograph wells.
Do build structure from 1px alpha hairlines (midnight at 14% or 32% on light, ivory at 18% or 42% on dark).
Do present repeated items as numbered rows, ruled lists or tables, with Archivo numerals 01 to 06 where the sequence is real.
Do keep photographs inside grid columns at 4:3, 3:2, 16:10, 3:4 or 1:1, 4px radius, with a caption below rather than text over the image.
Do set all reading text in STIX Two Text at weight 400 and all apparatus (labels, numerals, navigation, buttons) in Archivo 500 at 14px or below.
Do keep buttons at 44px tall with a 1px border and 4px radius, fill or ghost, with the 14px arrow only on the primary action.
Do keep motion brief and triggered: 220ms state changes, 420ms line travel, 600ms reveal, 700ms zoom, on cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), and honour prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't use box-shadow, drop-shadow, gradient fills, glows or blur anywhere; the only linear-gradient permitted is the scroll-edge mask on horizontal tab strips.
Don't build cards with icons, rounded corners above 4px, or any radius on elements other than buttons and photographs.
Don't run a full-bleed hero, a full-viewport section, a pinned scroll sequence, parallax or any looping animation.
Don't set type in bold, use a display or system face, or let Archivo carry sentences.
Don't use atlantic as a fill, heading colour or decoration; it exists for ghost hover and focus only.
Don't introduce gold, glowing blue, or a fourth ground colour.

Don't add eyebrows or kicker lines above headings. The two on the homepage (hero and quality) are owner-sanctioned exceptions to the craft floor, not a pattern for new surfaces; the label style belongs to column and field heads.
Don't use em dashes in any copy.
